# GrabPoseHandles

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Interaction` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Interaction/GrabPoseHandles.cs#L20)

Draws the hand's bones in the scene view so a grip can be posed by grabbing them directly.

Every bone carries a dot, always, whether or not anything is selected. Clicking one picks it
up and gives it a rotation handle. That is the whole point: a finger bone lives fifteen rows
deep in a hierarchy nobody wants to open, and having to find it there before touching it is
what made authoring a grip not worth doing.

The dots are drawn ignoring depth, because the bones are inside the hand mesh and would
otherwise be hidden by the very thing they pose.
